dentist.label: Dentist
dentist.why: Established clinics buy implants and orthodontics; a single extra case pays for the site.

lawyer.label: Law firm
lawyer.why: Consultation-driven; a working contact form is directly billable.

restaurant.label: Restaurant
restaurant.why: Menu, hours and booking are the whole job. Fast to deliver, low ticket.

plumber.label: Plumber
plumber.why: Emergency calls; click-to-call is the entire conversion path.

hvac.label: HVAC / AC repair
hvac.why: Seasonal spikes; a slow site costs bookings in the peak month.

real_estate.label: Real estate agent
real_estate.why: Listings and lead capture; high commission per enquiry.

gym.label: Gym / fitness studio
gym.why: Membership signup is a form; usually a dated site.

salon.label: Salon / spa
salon.why: Booking is the product; many run on Instagram only.

clinic.label: Medical clinic
clinic.why: Same logic as dentist — appointment flow and trust signals.
